title: Magnet Enchantment
description: Pull nearby items straight to you with the Magnet enchantment. Faster collection, longer reach, and smooth game play flow.
body:
![Magnet Enchantment](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/52ef627d06b780bb7d3cfdba840d4abd68ee6850.jpeg)

**Pull nearby items straight to you with the Magnet enchantment. Faster collection, longer reach, and smooth gameplay flow.**

The Magnet enchantment automatically attracts dropped items toward the player, reducing the need to manually pick up resources. It comes in three levels: Level I collects items within a 6 block radius, Level II extends the range to 8 blocks, and Level III reaches up to 10 blocks with near-instant pickup speed. Higher levels not only increase the range but also significantly improve collection speed, making resource gathering faster and more efficient.

Magnet can be obtained through multiple vanilla-friendly methods, including enchanting tables, loot, trading, and treasure sources. Designed as a quality-of-life enhancement, it integrates seamlessly into survival gameplay without breaking balance, while greatly improving mining, farming, and general exploration.

## Requirements:
- Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.5-26.1.2

## Installation:

### Singleplayer
- Open Minecraft
- Create a new world and click on "More", "Data Packs"
- Drag the data pack into the Minecraft window
- Click "Yes" on the confirmation screen
- Move the data pack to the right-hand side of the screen by clicking the triangle on its icon
- Click "Done" and continue creating your world, then click on "Create New World"

### Multiplayer
- Download the data pack
- Open your server folder, then open the folder of the world
- Put the data pack into a folder named datapacks
- Restart your server, and you can use your new datapack.

## Permissions:
- None
